passage and note: the passage id and the 0-based index of the note in its layers list in config/layers.json as of this commit. kind: the note's kind. source, on, at: the citation as it appears in the note. url: the page that was fetched on the date given. status: 'added' (new this batch) or 'confirmed' (already cited, re-read and found to state the point). counted: whether the writer counts toward the note's strength (3 or more distinct writers who state the point themselves: widely agreed; 2: commonly held; 1: some interpreters); a cite marked false supports part of the note or is a reference work.

quote: the writer's words as found on the fetched page, given only for public-domain writers; '...' joins parts that appear in that order on the page, and a bracketed verse such as [Mark 12:35] marks a part taken from a neighbouring heading. Spelling, misprints and OCR errors are the page's own. more: further lines from the same writer. pointer: for a modern copyrighted work, and for the Pulpit Commentary (Bible Hub's text carries BibleSoft's copyright notice), where on the page the point is made, with no quotation; more_pointer: the same for further lines.

Every quote was found on its page by a finder and matched again, on a fresh fetch, by a separate checker. removed_cites, dropped_notes, moved_outside_checked_notes and returned_passages record the other changes made to config/layers.json in this batch.
